field_descriptions.chemical_role: A role played by the BioChemEntity within a chemical context.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.in_ch_i: Non-proprietary identifier for molecular entity that can be used in printed and electronic data sources thus enabling easier linking of diverse data compilations.
field_descriptions.in_ch_i_key: InChIKey is a hashed version of the full InChI (using the SHA-256 algorithm).
field_descriptions.iupac_name: Systematic method of naming chemical compounds as recommended by the International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry (IUPAC).
field_descriptions.molecular_formula: The empirical formula is the simplest whole number ratio of all the atoms in a molecule.
field_descriptions.molecular_weight: This is the molecular weight of the entity being described, not of the parent. Units should be included in the form '<Number> <unit>', for example '12 amu' or as '<QuantitativeValue>.
field_descriptions.monoisotopic_molecular_weight: The monoisotopic mass is the sum of the masses of the atoms in a molecule using the unbound, ground-state, rest mass of the principal (most abundant) isotope for each element instead of the isotopic average mass. Please include the units in the form '<Number> <unit>', for example '770.230488 g/mol' or as '<QuantitativeValue>.
field_descriptions.potential_use: Intended use of the BioChemEntity by humans.
field_descriptions.smiles: A specification in form of a line notation for describing the structure of chemical species using short ASCII strings.  Double bond stereochemistry \ indicators may need to be escaped in the string in formats where the backslash is an escape character.
